artworks.title: Amphora with the Birth of Athena
artworks.description: Louvre amphora F 32: Athena springs fully armed from Zeus' head as Olympians look on — the Hesiodic birth fixed in Archaic black-figure.

artworks.title: Exaleiptron with the Birth of Athena
artworks.description: Louvre exaleiptron CA 616: Hephaestus' axe and the armed goddess rising from the skull — the same cosmogonic birth on a perfume vessel.

artworks.title: Birth of Athena (puteal relief)
artworks.description: Madrid puteal (cast in Pushkin): the birth in continuous relief — Zeus seated, Athena emerging, Eileithyia assisting the cry of war.

artworks.title: La Naissance de Minerve
artworks.description: Boullogne's French academic birth: Minerva rises armed from Jupiter's brow — the Renaissance–Baroque restaging of the Hesiodic axe-blow.

artworks.title: Birth of Minerva
artworks.description: Kuhn-Régnier's Art Deco plate returns Athena to the split skull — a modern illustrator's take on wisdom springing complete.

popCulture.title: Athena
popCulture.description: The fully armed birth from Zeus' head remains the West's image of wisdom springing complete — Hephaestus' axe and the cry of war.
